culprit_citations.quoted_text: BCRED Verdelite JV LP Consolidated Schedule of Investments December 31, 2023 (in thousands)

rationale: B02 reports duplicate position keys, with BroadStreet Partners Inc. Verdelite JV LP as the example. The raw Verdelite JV schedule has two BroadStreet Partners rows, but they are distinct tranches: one is SOFR + 3.75%, 9.11%, maturing 1/27/2029 with fair value 3,318, and the other is SOFR + 3.00%, 8.47%, maturing 1/27/2027 with fair value 3,311. The duplicate-key check is collapsing legitimate separate source positions rather than finding duplicated extraction rows.
